The '''1957–58 Federation Cup''' was the second season of the [[Turkish Federation Cup]]. The winner of the competition would represent Turkey at the [[1958–59 European Cup]]. It was also the last edition of the Federation Cup, for the next season would be the [[Süper Lig|Turkish First Football League]]. 38 clubs participated: 20 from [[Istanbul Football League|Istanbul]], 10 from [[İzmir Football League|İzmir]], and 8 from [[Ankara Football League|Ankara]]. [[Beşiktaş J.K.|Beşiktaş]] won the title for the second time.
